title: Clause variant intelligence only implemented for NDA
description: 28 clause families defined in data/documents/clause-families.json with 9 drafting positions each, but only NDA clause families (confidentiality.*, ip.background, disputes.courts) have actual variant implementations in getClauseVariant(). Remaining 22 families return null.
impact: Users can request alternative positions (customer-friendly, supplier-friendly, etc.) but only get results for NDA clauses. Other documents cannot use clause intelligence features.
root_cause: getClauseVariant() in document-engine.js only has hardcoded variants for confidentiality.duration. No systematic variant generation from clause-families.json.
remediation: Implement variant templates in clause-families.json for all families, or build programmatic variant generator.
regression_test: Clause variant test: all 28 families should return non-null for at least NEUTRAL position.
